messages:
olivia: quick RFC follow-up: propose decomposing the embeddings pipeline into three explicit pieces: Embed Compute (hot GPU service), Norm & Dedup (fast CPU/serving layer), and Vector Store (offline/scale persistence). goal: reduce blast radius, enable independent scaling & cost attribution, and make deterministic hashing explicit for dedupe/compaction. looking for runbook/rollout feedback.
matt: +1 to surface ownership. main question: what do we guarantee about determinism across model versions & quantization? embedding values can drift. we need a hash contract that is stable or at least versioned. :thinking:
sarah: suggest publishing a hashing manifest: embed-model-id + tokenization-spec + normalization-steps + float-format. hash output should be semantic (post-normalization) and include a manifest version. when model or norm changes, bump manifest.
derek: operational concerns: splitting adds extra RPC hops on the hotpath. ensure Norm & Dedup is extremely low-latency and colocated when required. for interactive tenants maybe we keep a colocated L1 cache.
olivia: plan: keep embed compute minimal: produce raw vectors + model-meta. Norm & Dedup receives vector, applies deterministic norm (L2 or cosine-normalize) + canonicalization (lowercasing, unicode normalize if text), then computes dedupe-key and optionally drops duplicates. Vector Store accepts canonical vector + metadata.
matt: rollout phases idea: 1) externalize Norm & Dedup as a sidecar (dry-run) 2) run compare job: compute norm+hash in batch on historical data and compare keys 3) enable live sidecar for low-traffic tenants with dual-write to Vector Store and to the legacy store 4) monitor index cardinality, recall, and cost 5) cutover and deprecate old pipeline after 21d.
sarah: parity checks should include: embedding L2 diff distribution, cosine drift CDF, dedupe-key match rate, and downstream RAG recall on a sample query set. thresholds: median cosine drift < 1e-3, dedupe-key mismatch < 0.1% for stable models. if exceeded, fail the cutover.
derek: cache strategy: L1 in-process for p95 fast hits, L2 shared memcached/redis colocated in zone for cross-replica hits. the Norm service should be idempotent and side-effect free. also include a signature on dedupe-keys so we can detect mismatches after an attempted rollback.
olivia: ownership: eng-ml owns norm spec and manifest publication; eng-storage owns vector store; platform owns sidecar runtime and SLOs. need cost allocation tags on compute & storage.
matt: storage compaction: propose a compaction job that merges close vectors based on dedupe-key and TTLs. but compaction can change indices; require snapshot and immutable compaction deltas. schedule as offline windows per-tenant.
sarah: security & privacy: embeddings for private tenants should be isolated; normalize/dedupe must respect tenant-scoped salts before hashing if dedupe across tenants is not allowed. manifest must include salt-policy (per-tenant or global).
derek: observability: traces should include model-id, manifest-version, dedupe-key, and whether the vector was dropped as duplicate. add a daily report of dedupe-rate by tenant and index-size growth.
olivia: ops checklist draft: ```- define norm manifest proto (json) with fields: model-id, tokenizer-spec, norm-algo, float-format, salt-policy, manifest-version
- implement Norm & Dedup service (dry-run mode) with signed manifests
- backfill compare job (200k embeddings) compute: L2-diff, cosine-drift, dedupe-key-match-rate, downstream-recall
- deploy sidecar to staging; enable dry-run for cohort A (5 tenants)
- enable dual-write to both vector stores for cohort A; monitor metrics and alerts
- ramp cohorts B,C -> global if thresholds met
- schedule compaction & cleanup job and a 3-sprint play to remove legacy code paths after 21d
```
matt: rollback safety: keep legacy dedupe and store writable for at least 14d after cutover; route 5% of traffic to legacy path for a brief verification window. if drift > threshold -> flip. also require a signed manifest rollback endpoint.
sarah: small add: store manifest in the artifact registry with provenance (who published, toolchain, commit) and ensure runtime verifies the manifest signature (KMS). infra-bot: artifact registry note: "embedding-manifests-v1" schema accepted.
derek: performance test: simulate L1-miss storms and measure added p99; instrument prewarm latencies and set a target p99 delta < 20ms for interactive tenants. also add backpressure if Vector Store responds slow (queue length circuit).
olivia: privacy note again: for dedicated/private customers we must allow an opt-out for cross-tenant dedupe. manifest must support per-tenant salt and a flag for cross-tenant-dedupe-enabled.
sarah: evaluation: add a regression job to eval-engine that runs retrieval quality (R@k) and embedding drift snapshots per manifest version. store snapshots in audit logs.
matt: ownership & billing: require infra-cost tag on all Norm & Dedup runs; product must sign off on storage compaction schedules that might affect recall.
olivia: I'll update the RFC with manifest proto, rollout gates, performance targets, and the ops checklist. please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the sequence and owners.
